metaDesc: Cold press machine MH3248x150Tx3, table size per section 1250×1500mm, opening distance 1300mm, for plywood and veneer pre-pressing. Factory direct from China.
description: cold press machine MH3248x150Tx3 from Shang Rui Machinery. table size per section 1250×1500mm, opening distance 1300mm, pressure per section 50TBuilt for plywood and veneer production lines, this hydraulic cold press applies uniform pressure to glue-wiped veneer stacks before the hot press stage, improving board flatness and reducing rejects. Supplied by Shang Rui Machinery with CE certification on core models, technical support and lifetime spare parts availability.

faq.q: What is the maximum pressing pressure of the Cold Press MH3248x150Tx3?
faq.a: The Cold Press MH3248x150Tx3 delivers up to the rated capacity of pressing force, which covers standard plywood and veneer panel sizes.

faq.q: What size of board can this cold press handle?
faq.a: The working table measures the rated table size, so standard plywood board sizes fit directly for pre-pressing glued veneer stacks.

faq.q: What power supply does this machine need?
faq.a: It runs on 380V/415V three-phase, the standard three-phase industrial supply used in most woodworking factories.

faq.q: Does Shang Rui supply spare parts and after-sales support?
faq.a: Yes. Spare parts are available for the life of the machine, and our engineers support installation, commissioning and operator training.
